name: print-social-distressed-red-portfolio-title-on-cream-paper
title: Cropped portfolio cover with giant distressed red condensed letters on cream paper
whatItIs: A cream paper-textured cover with a tiny red name at the top left, enormous distressed dark-red condensed letters spelling PORTFOLIO cropped at the left, a wide-tracked red 'GRAPHIC DESIGNER' under it and category words along a rule at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Raw and confident; distressed letters look printed and worn.
techniques: Set giant condensed letters cropped by the frame.
Use a rule with category list.

vocabulary.definition: A title cut by the frame.
A line with service words beneath.
